title: Alert Configuration
content: Alert Configuration is where you set KPI thresholds and notification rules for every cryotank across all branches.

title: Open Alert Configuration
content: Click Alert Config to expand it. Alerts are configured per device type, so it opens into Cryotanks, Incubators and Refrigerators.

title: Choose Cryotanks
content: Each device type has its own KPIs and thresholds. Click Cryotanks to configure alerts for your liquid nitrogen tanks.

title: Branch Filter
content: The selector bar at the top holds your Branch and Cryotank pickers. Start with the Branch pill to narrow the list to one location — useful when you manage tanks across several sites.

title: Select Bangalore
content: Click Bangalore to filter the cryotank list down to the tanks at this branch.

title: Cryotank Selector
content: Now pick the tank you want to configure. Click this pill to see the active cryotanks in Bangalore.

title: Select Cryotank T-161
content: Click Cryotank T-161 to load its alert configuration.

title: Configuration Panel
content: Each card here is one KPI for this tank. A card shows the latest live reading, its alert threshold, and which channels get notified — all editable in place.

title: Internal Temperature
content: The cryogenic temperature where samples sit. Drag the two slider handles to set the safe Min and Max, or type exact values in the boxes below. The green marker shows the latest reading against your range.

title: Alert On / Off
content: This switch is the master control for the KPI. Turn it off and the thresholds grey out and nothing is sent, no matter what the reading does. Everything else on this bar only applies while it is on.

title: WhatsApp Alerts
content: Sends the alert straight to WhatsApp — the fastest way to reach whoever is on call. A green dot means the channel is live. Repeats are throttled so one ongoing breach cannot flood the team: one hour between messages to the user, two hours to admins.

title: Email Alerts
content: Sends the alert by email, giving you a written record for audits. Email is also the channel Mail Escalation uses, so it has to be on before you can escalate.

title: Alert Level
content: Your channel choice also sets how urgent the alert is. With email on it is saved as a Critical alert; with only WhatsApp or in-app it stays a Soft alert. That level is what the alerting engine uses to prioritise, so reserve email for KPIs that genuinely warrant waking someone.

title: Mail Escalation
content: Your safety net for alerts nobody acts on. Set a number and if that many alerts in a row go unacknowledged, it escalates by email to admins and managers — zero escalates immediately. It needs email switched on, and clears itself if you turn email back off.

title: LN2 Level
content: Liquid nitrogen remaining, in kilograms. The 3D dewar mirrors the live fill level and the orange marker tracks your Min threshold, so you can see the safety margin at a glance.

title: Lid State
content: A simple open or closed alert — no range to set. It fires when the lid is opened, catching accidental openings that could warm the tank and compromise samples.

title: External Temperature
content: Ambient room temperature around the tank. A sustained rise here often explains a faster evaporation rate, so it is useful early-warning context.

title: Evaporation Rate
content: How fast liquid nitrogen is boiling off, in kg per hour. Alerting on an unusually high rate lets you catch a failing vacuum jacket before the level itself becomes critical.

title: Humidity
content: Moisture in the air around the tank. High humidity accelerates ice build-up on the lid and fittings.

title: Battery Level
content: Charge left in the monitoring device. Set a Min so you are warned while there is still time to swap or recharge it — a flat sensor means no readings at all.

title: Shock Detection
content: Impacts or sudden movement, measured in G. Useful for flagging rough handling during a move or transport.

title: Set Recommended
content: Rather than tuning each KPI by hand, click Set Recommended to fill every card with safe defaults and switch those alerts on. Nothing is applied until you save.

title: Save Changes
content: The bar at the bottom counts your unsaved edits and stays in view while you work. Click Save Changes to apply the recommended thresholds to this tank.

title: Copy to Other Tanks
content: Once a tank is configured the way you want, Copy to Other Tanks applies the same thresholds to any other cryotanks you select — so you only set it up once.

title: Config History
content: Config History opens the audit trail for this tank — every threshold change and alert it has raised, with who changed what and when.

title: Configuration Saved
content: Cryotank T-161 is now fully configured: internal and external temperature, LN2 level, evaporation rate, humidity, battery, shock and lid state — each with its own thresholds and notification channels.
